title: A guided reflection
body: Walk through the question with your guide, one step at a time.
instruction: Use Next to move through the conversation. You can replay it at any time.

_messages.text: Let's look back at the task you just finished. What was the first thing you tried?
I jumped straight to the calculation without checking the units.
That's a really common move. What did that cost you later on?
I had to redo the last two steps once I spotted the mismatch.
So where could a thirty-second check have saved you those two steps?
Right at the start — before I touched the numbers.
